description: Move a page, with its child pages, under another page or to the top level of its space. Give parent_page to nest it, or top_level: true to put it at the top. To move it into another space of the same workspace, also give space; the new parent must then be in that space (or use top_level). Space-scoped tokens can only move pages within their own space.

page.description: Page UUID or "workspaceSlug/spaceSlug/pageSlug" path of the page to move

parent_page.description: New parent page: UUID or "workspaceSlug/spaceSlug/pageSlug" path. Leave out with top_level: true.

space.description: Destination space, only when moving to another space: UUID or "workspaceSlug/spaceSlug" path. Same workspace only.

top_level.description: When true, move the page to the top level of its space (no parent). Don't combine with parent_page.

name: move_page
title: Move page
